parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating record details — the `members` array is empty and `differing_slots`, `shared_ancestor`, and `shared_field_count` are all null. The only grounded evidence is the file paths (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/PlaybackState.swift` and `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/PlayerState.swift`) and a Jaccard similarity of 0.83, but without field or method lists it is impossible to determine which members are shared, which diverge, or whether the two types encode the same domain concept. Recommending a merge or extraction without that evidence would risk conflating two intentionally distinct state representations (`PlaybackState` vs `PlayerState`) that may serve different roles in the playback pipeline. Per the decision rules, when evidence cannot be grounded in the cluster row, the safe default is no-action.
